name: simple-code
description: Reduce incidental complexity in code and design with a bias toward concrete, local, reversible solutions.

interface.shortDescription: Keep code and designs simple, local, and reversible.
interface.longDescription: Shape APIs, module boundaries, refactors, tests, naming, and architecture tradeoffs toward the simplest design that meets the real requirement, drawing on Grug, Worse Is Better, A Philosophy of Software Design, and The Laws of Simplicity.
defaultPrompt: Simplify this module without changing behavior.
Review this API design for unnecessary abstraction.
What is the simplest architecture that meets these requirements?
